verdict.rationale: No first-party export feature is documented, but data can be pulled out through the public REST API, which exchanges JSON over HTTPS (attio-docs-65), and through SQL queries against workspace data (attio-docs-4). Getting a full copy this way means building your own extraction script, with filtering/sorting (attio-docs-6) and 429 rate-limit handling (attio-docs-32). Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-workspace export, CSV or other open-format export from the UI, export of activity/history/attachments, offboarding documentation, and independent confirmation that complete data extraction works.
